REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - MARCH 24, 2022 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the COVID-19 pandemic and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-08-21, and subsequently by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021) and City Council Resolution No. 2022-10 adopted pursuant thereto, this meeting may also be conducted via teleconference, if necessary. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in-person in the Council Chamber subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Report from City Manager/Executive Director
During this part of the meeting the City Manager/Executive Director or designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior City Council meeting, including any request by the City Council to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior City Council meeting's agenda.
11B.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
12.
Closed Session
If the City Council adjourns to Closed Session, the City Council/Successor Agency will reconvene into Open Session after its conclusion and designated City staff will provide a verbal report on any reportable action taken. This report will be memorialized in the official meeting minutes.
13.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY,
MARCH 24, 2022, 7:00 P.M., IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  A proclamation was made by the City Council as follows:

  American Classic Escrow Corporation (Business Spotlight).

5B.  Informational update on the April 12, 2022 Cerritos General Municipal Election.

  An informational update was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Elections Official. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  Informational update on the City's response to the COVID-19 pandemic and other City
  events, services, and programs.

  An informational update was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  There was no action taken on these items.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Ben Z. Nyende spoke regarding his artwork and requested the opportunity to present an art
  proposal to the City and schools in the surrounding area.

  Patricia Murray spoke regarding her campaign for election to the Cerritos City Council. She
  inquired as to the schedule for repaving Studebaker Road near the mall, and her support
  for by-district elections.

  Rocky Pavone spoke regarding his campaign for election to the Cerritos City Council.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  Sam Desai spoke regarding his campaign for election to the Cerritos City Council.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor
  declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Thursday, March 10, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
  Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Yokoyama, to approve the Thursday,
  March 10, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated March 24, 2022 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Yokoyama, to approve the Register of
  Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  March 24, 2022  $ 4,300,801.97 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.2. Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency
  dated March 24, 2022 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Yokoyama, to approve the Register of
  Demands as follows:

  Successor Agency  March 24, 2022  $ 17,500.00 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 6

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  Award of contract for C-2 Booster Pump Station backup generator system, Project No.
  22503, Bid No. 1451-22 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Yokoyama, to:

  1. Authorize a budget amendment for the appropriation of additional funds in the amount
  of $35,123.10 from the Water Fund for Project No. 22503, C-2 Booster Pump Station
  Backup Generator System;

  2. Award a contract in the amount of $80,123.10 for C-2 Booster Pump Station Backup
  Generator System, Project No. 22503 to Affordable Generator Services, Inc. and reject
  all other bids; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute any project-related change orders
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Award of contract for Citywide athletic court resurfacing, Project No. 22101, Bid No. 1448-
  22 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Yokoyama, to:

  1. Waive bid irregularity and include the late-received bid as part of the consideration of
  all other duly-received bids for purposes of determining the award of contract;

  2. Authorize a budget amendment for the appropriation of additional funds in the amount
  of $61,240 from the General Fund for Project No. 22101, Citywide Athletic Court
  Resurfacing;

  3. Award a contract in the amount of $96,240 for Citywide Athletic Court Resurfacing,
  Project No. 22101, to Cinbad Industry, Inc. and reject all other bids; and

  4. Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute any project-related change orders
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

(minutes continue on the next page)

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Recommendation of the Cerritos Planning Commission, on a vote of 5-0, to approve the
  following:

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVING THE CITY OF CERRITOS 2021 GENERAL PLAN
  ANNUAL PROGRESS REPORT FOR SUBMITTAL TO THE CALIFORNIA GOVERNOR'S OFFICE
  OF PLANNING AND RESEARCH (OPR) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Director of Community Development. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to provide information on a future
  agenda related to the methodology for conducting the annual evaluation of residents’ open
  space/recreational needs (Program No. OSR-2, Open Space/Recreation Element – 2021
  General Plan Annual Progress).

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments period. Noting there were no
  individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period and public hearing closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Solanki, to waive full reading of and
  adopt Resolution No. 2022-16, A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL
  APPROVING THE CITY OF CERRITOS 2021 GENERAL PLAN ANNUAL PROGRESS
  REPORT FOR SUBMITTAL TO THE CALIFORNIA GOVERNOR'S OFFICE OF PLANNING
  AND RESEARCH (OPR) (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for professional services for City of
  Cerritos website design and hosting, RFP No. 1431-21 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Laurie Kajiwara, Public Information Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to defer consideration of this item
  until after the matter is considered by the City’s Technology/MIS subcommittee (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, March 24, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 5 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS CONSENTING TO A REQUEST FOR ASSIGNMENT OF
  THE INTEGRATED SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT TO ATHENS
  SERVICES (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Mike O’Grady, Utilities Administrator. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written correspondence:
  (Written correspondence is considered public record and full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  Sue Carter submitted written correspondence expressing concern with the City’s potential
  reassignment of the subject services agreement to Athens Services.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor
  declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Vo, to waive full reading of and
  adopt Resolution No. 2022-17, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF CERRITOS CONSENTING TO A REQUEST FOR ASSIGNMENT OF THE
  INTEGRATED SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT TO ATHENS
  SERVICES (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  An informational report on AB 1597, AB 1599, and AB 1603 was given by Kathy
  Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  Reports

11A.  Report from City Manager/Executive Director

  An informational report related to the City’s credit card use policy was given by Art
  Gallucci, City Manager and Ryan Carey, Finance Manager.

11B.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports

  Reports were given by Mayor Pro Tem Vo and Councilmembers Solanki and Yokoyama.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 10:00 p.m. in memory of Beth Kiyoko Nielsen.
